question: Which American President has written ‘Dreams from My Father’, an autobiography?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Barack Obama**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Barack Obama** is the **44th President of the United States** and served two terms from **2009 to 2017**.
 
• He is the first African-American President of the United States.
 
• The book '**Dreams from My Father**' is an **autobiography** written by Barack Obama, first published in **1995**.
